findings.claim: The existing AddressBookDeletedEventSchema is rewritten to reuse AddressBookEntrySchema, an opportunistic cleanup of code outside the task's stated scope, which the PR description records only as adding entries to the enum for this file. It should instead restore payload: z.object({ address: AddressSchema, name: z.string() }) on AddressBookDeletedEventSchema and leave the two new request event schemas as the only additions here.

This file carries no behavioral change, only a blank line and a single-use decrypted intermediate variable, and is unrelated to the audit-log change and unlisted in the PR description. It should be reverted to its base-branch content.

The new reject/create test cases hard-code the asserted contact name as "Alice" (also at line 135) even though no assertion depends on that exact value, while the sibling entity spec in the same PR uses faker for the equivalent value. The name should be generated with faker.person.fullName() and that value used at both sites.
